verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documents a first-party MCP server: every project comes with one automatically configured to interact with the project's data. You connect it by copying the MCP Server URL into MCP-capable assistants such as ChatGPT and Cursor, which covers the core of agents using search indexes as a tool. The docs only say agents can 'interact with your data', which implies querying but does not spell out the tool surface, and the capability is Cloud-only. Missing for 10: documented analytics tools exposed via MCP, documented index/data-source management operations via MCP, an explicit tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
